knowledge:
- key_parameters: threshold=Score/rank threshold for filtering miRanda target predictions (e.g., 140 or 150) ;; scale=Scaling factor applied to the regression models (e.g., 100 or 10) ;; family=Statistical distribution assumption, such as glm_gaussian(), glm_poisson(), glm_nb(), glm_zeroinfl(), or glm_multi() ;; mode=Set to "multi" for multivariate models or "inter" for interaction/synergy models ;; pthreshold=P-value threshold for filtering differentially expressed mRNAs (default is 0.05) ;; Shrounds=Number of shuffling rounds to generate background distributions ;; Srounds=Number of sampling rounds to generate background distributions
- alternatives: SPONGE package=Mentioned for sparse partial correlation analysis using elastic net via miranda_sponge_predict and one2manySponge. Prefer SPONGE when sample size is large (100+ samples) and miRNA/mRNA variance is high.
- when_to_use: Use when matching miRNA and mRNA expression data (TPM, RPKM, or counts) are available from the same experiment/samples (either across a cohort or across multiple time points) and you want to identify statistically significant miRNA-mRNA target interactions supported by sequence-based target predictions.
- pitfalls: Do not use the SPONGE / one2manySponge method for low sample sizes (20 or less) or low-variance miRNAs/mRNAs, as confidence decreases; use Part 1 regression models instead ;; Running all-to-all multinomial models (glm_multi with many miRNAs) can take a very long time and require high memory; it is highly recommended to pre-select specific miRNAs ;; Ensure that if normalized data (TPM/RPKM) is used for mRNA, the same normalization is used for miRNA.

workflows.name: mirna_mrna_regression_cohorts
workflows.intent: Identify miRNA-mRNA target interactions in a cohort using various GLM regression models integrated with miRanda predictions.
workflows.stages: 1. Load mRNA and miRNA expression data ;; 2. Retrieve species-specific miRanda target predictions using getInputSpecies ;; 3. Filter mRNA data to keep only predicted targets using miRanComp ;; 4. Combine mRNA and miRNA data for selected miRNAs using combiner and geneVari ;; 5. Run univariate or multivariate GLM models using runModel or runModels with specified families (e.g., glm_gaussian(), glm_poisson(), glm_nb(), glm_zeroinfl(), glm_multi()) ;; 6. Evaluate model performance using AIC values and select the best-fitting model ;; 7. Run all-to-all combinations using runAllMirnaModels
workflows.code:
DiffExp<-read.table(get_test_file("EBV_mRNA.txt.gz"), as.is=TRUE, header=TRUE, row.names=1)
miRNAExp<-read.table(get_test_file("EBV_miRNA.txt.gz"), as.is=TRUE, header=TRUE, row.names=1)
miRanda <- getInputSpecies("Epstein_Barr", threshold = 140)
DiffExpmRNASub <- miRanComp(DiffExp, miRanda)
miRNA_select<-c("ebv-mir-BART9-5p")
Combine <- combiner(DiffExp, miRNAExp, miRNA_select)
geneVariant <- geneVari(Combine, miRNA_select)
j <- runModel(`LMP-1` ~ `ebv-mir-BART9-5p`,
              Combine, model = glm_poisson(),
              scale = 100)
print(modelTermPvalues(j))
blaGaus <- runModels(Combine,
                     geneVariant, miRNA_select,
                     family = glm_gaussian(),
                     scale = 100)
par(oma=c(2,2,2,2))
par(mfrow=c(2,3),mar=c(4,3,3,2))
plot(blaGaus[["all_models"]][["BHLF1"]])
plot(modelData(blaGaus[["all_models"]][["BHLF1"]]))
G <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, blaGaus[["AICvalues"]])
names(G) <- c("AIC_G")
plot(density(G$AIC_G))
GM <- melt(G)
blaPois <- runModels(Combine,
                     geneVariant, miRNA_select,
                     family = glm_poisson(),
                     scale = 100)
par(oma=c(2,2,2,2))
par(mfrow=c(2,3),mar=c(4,3,3,2))
plot(blaPois[["all_models"]][["LMP-2A"]])
plot(modelData(blaPois[["all_models"]][["LMP-2A"]]))
P <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, blaPois[["AICvalues"]])
names(P) <- c("AIC_Po")
PM <- melt(P)
blaNB <- runModels(Combine,
                   geneVariant, miRNA_select,
                   family = glm_nb(), scale = 100)
par(mar=c(4,3,3,2))
plot(modelData(blaNB[["all_models"]][["BALF1"]]))
B <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, blaNB[["AICvalues"]])
names(B) <- c("AIC_NB")
BM <- melt(B)
blazeroinflNB <- runModels(Combine, geneVariant,
                            miRNA_select,
                            family = glm_zeroinfl(dist = "negbin"),
                            scale = 100)
ZNB <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, blazeroinflNB[["AICvalues"]])
names(ZNB) <- c("AIC_ZNB")
par(mar=c(4,3,3,2))
plot(density(ZNB$AIC_ZNB))
ZNBM<-melt(ZNB)
blazeroinfl <- runModels(Combine, geneVariant,
                         miRNA_select,
                         family = glm_zeroinfl(),
                         scale = 100)
Zp <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, blazeroinfl[["AICvalues"]])
names(Zp) <- c("AIC_Zp")
par(mar=c(4,3,3,2))
plot(density(Zp$AIC_Zp))
ZpM <- melt(Zp)
bindM <- rbind(PM, BM, GM, ZpM, ZNBM)
p2 <- ggplot(data = bindM, aes(x = value, group = variable,
                               fill = variable)) +
  geom_density(adjust = 1.5, alpha = .3) +
  xlim(-400, 2000)+
  ggtitle("Plot of of AIC for ebv-mir-BART9-5p regressed all mRNAs ")+
  ylab("Density")+ xlab ("AIC Value")
p2
miRNA_select<-c("ebv-mir-BART9-5p","ebv-mir-BART6-3p")
Combine <- combiner(DiffExp, miRNAExp, miRNA_select)
geneVariant <- geneVari(Combine, miRNA_select)
MultiModel <- runModels(Combine, geneVariant,
                        miRNA_select, family = glm_multi(),
                        mode="multi", scale = 10)
print(table(unlist(lapply(MultiModel$all_models, modelModelName))))
InterModel <- runModels(Combine,
                        geneVariant, miRNA_select,
                        family = glm_multi(
                          models=list(glm_gaussian,
                          glm_poisson())),mode="inter", scale = 10)
print(table(unlist(lapply(InterModel$all_models, modelModelName))))
vMiRNA<-rownames(miRNAExp)
All_miRNAs_run<-runAllMirnaModels(mirnas =vMiRNA[1:5] ,
                                  DiffExpmRNA = DiffExpmRNASub,
                                  DiffExpmiRNA = miRNAExp,
                                  miranda_data = miRanda,prob=0.75,
                                  cutoff=0.05,fdr_cutoff = 0.1, method = "fdr",
                                  family = glm_multi(), scale = 2, mode="multi")
hasgenes <- lapply(All_miRNAs_run, function(x) nrow(x$SigFDRGenes)) > 0
All_miRNAs_run <- All_miRNAs_run[hasgenes]
print(table(unlist(lapply
                   (All_miRNAs_run[[1]][["FDRModel"]][["all_models"]],
                     modelModelName))))
print(
  table(
    unlist(lapply(
      (All_miRNAs_run[["ebv-mir-BART1-5p and ebv-mir-BART11-3p"]]
                     [["FDRModel"]]
                     [["all_models"]]),
        modelModelName))))
try({
sponge_mir_input<-miranda_sponge_predict(miRNAExp,DiffExp,miRanda)
one2many_output<-one2manySponge(miRNAExp,DiffExp,sponge_mir_input)
})

workflows.name: mirna_mrna_correlation_multi_timepoint
workflows.intent: Identify significant miRNA-mRNA correlations across three or more time points using fold change data and background distribution comparisons.
input: mRNA_timepoints.txt.gz (mRNA fold change files across time points)
miRNA_timepoints.txt.gz (miRNA fold change files across time points)
workflows.stages: 1. Load time-point specific differential expression files for mRNA and miRNA ;; 2. Parse fold changes and filter mRNAs by p-value threshold using one2OneRnaMiRNA ;; 3. Calculate Pearson correlation between mRNA and miRNA fold changes using corMirnaRna ;; 4. Generate a background correlation distribution using sampCorRnaMirna ;; 5. Plot correlation density using mirRnaDensityCor ;; 6. Identify significant correlations below a threshold using threshSig ;; 7. Retrieve species-specific miRanda target predictions using getInputSpecies ;; 8. Intersect significant correlations with miRanda predictions using corMirnaRnaMiranda or miRandaIntersect ;; 9. Visualize results with a heatmap using mirRnaHeatmap
workflows.code:
files <- local({
  filenames <- list.files(path=get_test_file(), pattern="^.*\\.txt\\.gz$",
                          full.names=TRUE)
  files <- lapply(filenames, read.table, as.is=TRUE, header=TRUE, sep="\t")
  names(files) <- gsub("^.*/(.*)\\.txt\\.gz$", "\\1", filenames)
  return(files)
})
mrna_files <- files[grep("^mRNA", names(files))]
mrna <- one2OneRnaMiRNA(mrna_files, pthreshold = 0.05)$foldchanges
mirna_files <- files[grep("^miRNA", names(files))]
mirna <- one2OneRnaMiRNA(mirna_files)$foldchanges
corr_0 <- corMirnaRna(mrna, mirna,method="pearson")
outs <- sampCorRnaMirna(mrna, mirna,method="pearson",
                        Shrounds = 100, Srounds = 1000)
mirRnaDensityCor(corr_0, outs)
sig_corrs <- threshSig(corr_0, outs,pvalue = 0.05)
miRanda <- getInputSpecies("Mouse", threshold = 150)
newcorr <- corMirnaRnaMiranda(mrna, mirna, -0.7, miRanda)
mirRnaHeatmap(newcorr,upper_bound = -0.6)
results <- miRandaIntersect(sig_corrs, outs, mrna, mirna, miRanda)
p<- mirRnaHeatmap(results$corr,upper_bound =-0.99)
p

workflows.name: mirna_mrna_relationship_two_timepoint
workflows.intent: Identify significant miRNA-mRNA fold change differences between two time points compared to a background distribution.
input: mRNA0_5.txt.gz (mRNA fold change files for two time points)
miRNA0_5.txt.gz (miRNA fold change files for two time points)
workflows.stages: 1. Load differential expression files for mRNA and miRNA ;; 2. Parse fold changes and filter mRNAs by p-value threshold using one2OneRnaMiRNA ;; 3. Estimate miRNA-mRNA fold change differences using twoTimePoint ;; 4. Generate a background distribution of fold change differences using twoTimePointSamp ;; 5. Retrieve species-specific miRanda target predictions using getInputSpecies ;; 6. Identify relationships below a p-value threshold using threshSigInter ;; 7. Intersect significant relationships with miRanda predictions using mirandaIntersectInter ;; 8. Format final results using finInterResult ;; 9. Draw fold change plots using drawInterPlots and a heatmap using mirRnaHeatmapDiff
workflows.code:
files <- local({
  filenames <- list.files(path=get_test_file(), pattern="^.*\\.txt\\.gz$",
                          full.names=TRUE)
  files <- lapply(filenames, read.table, as.is=TRUE, header=TRUE, sep="\t")
  names(files) <- gsub("^.*/(.*)\\.txt\\.gz$", "\\1", filenames)
  return(files)
})
mirna_files <- files[grep("^miRNA0_5", names(files))]
mrna_files <- files[grep("^mRNA0_5", names(files))]
mrna <- one2OneRnaMiRNA(mrna_files, pthreshold = 0.05)$foldchanges
mirna <- one2OneRnaMiRNA(mirna_files)$foldchanges
inter0 <- twoTimePoint(mrna, mirna)
outs <- twoTimePointSamp(mrna, mirna,Shrounds = 10 )
miRanda <- getInputSpecies("Mouse", threshold = 140)
sig_InterR <- threshSigInter(inter0, outs)
results <- mirandaIntersectInter(sig_InterR, outs, mrna, mirna, miRanda)
final_results <- finInterResult(results)
par(mar=c(4,4,2,1))
drawInterPlots(mrna,mirna,final_results)
CorRes<-results$corrs
mirRnaHeatmapDiff(CorRes,upper_bound = 9.9)
